$comment: Shared parity fixture. BOTH the TypeScript suite (packages/schemas/src/*.test.ts) and the Python suite (python/libs/schemas/tests/test_parity.py) load this file and assert the same things about it. The Zod mirror and the Pydantic models are hand-authored, so this file is what stops them drifting: a field added on one side and forgotten on the other fails here, in the suite that did not change. Owned by neither side. When codegen lands, this becomes the codegen's own conformance suite rather than going away.

declination_without_reason.$comment: FR-307: a silent decline is indistinguishable from a bug.

routing_selects_head_construction_withou.$comment: FR-307's deterministic half. No producer, model or otherwise, can select head construction past a gate that found no face.

value.rationale: the artist asked for a head study

routing_without_a_rationale.$comment: The rationale is what the artist reads. An empty one is a routing summary that says nothing.

routing_decision_with_an_unknown_field.$comment: Both sides refuse an unknown field. Zod strips one by default, which is the drift this case pins.

intent_with_unsupported_medium.$comment: pastel, gouache and digital are deliberately out of scope for the first version — accepted-and-planned-badly is worse than refused.

run_failure_with_an_unknown_reason.$comment: The studio localizes the reason, so an unlisted one has no message to show.

run_failure_carrying_an_upstream_body.$comment: Strict on both sides: no field for an upstream error body to ride in on.
